note: Core Templar skill specializations for the global build, transcribed from Solashur's in-game spec panels (Questlog). 'picked: true' = the specialization is selected in this build. Icons live in /assets.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.desc: Deals damage to a target within 4m and increases Enmity. 5 Stagger Gauge Damage.

specs.text: Deals extra damage vs targets afflicted with Impact-type status

skills.name: Punishment
skills.desc: Selects a target within 20m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m; grants the Executor effect (Accuracy +200, PvE Damage +20%, PvP Damage +10%) for 20s. Max 3 Charge Levels.

specs.text: Inflicts Damage over Time to target on hit
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

skills.name: Battlefield Banner
skills.desc: Increases Attack proportional to Defense for 22.5s.

skills.name: Nezekan's Shield
skills.desc: Grants a Protective Shield that blocks damage equaling 45% of Max HP for 3s to the caster and nearby party members within 40m.

specs.text: +20% all Element Tolerance for Protective Shield duration
+20% PvE Damage Tolerance and +10% PvP Damage Tolerance for Protective Shield duration
Restores 20% of Max HP when Protective Shield is removed

skills.name: Doom Shield
skills.desc: Rushes to a target within 20m and deals damage. 75% chance to inflict Knockdown for 3s. Grants a Protective Shield (5% Max HP for 5s) on hit. Triggers [Judgment] for 3s. 100% chance to inflict Knockdown on NPC targets. 20 Stagger Gauge Damage.

specs.text: Resets cooldown on defeating an enemy

skills.name: Executing Blade
skills.desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and reduces Defense by 30% for 5s. Deals 20% more damage vs targets afflicted with Impact-type status. 20 Stagger Gauge Damage.

specs.text: +30% damage vs targets afflicted with Impact-type status
+3% all skill cooldowns of the target on hit

skills.name: Empyrean Lord's Punishment
skills.desc: Selects a target within 20m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m with a 50% chance to inflict Stun for 3s. 100% chance to inflict Stun on NPC targets. 50 Stagger Gauge Damage.

specs.text: Up to +20% damage when fewer targets hit
+10% PvE Damage Boost and +5% PvP Damage Boost for 10s on hit
+200% damage to targets with Incapacitated Immunity

skills.name: Pummel
skills.desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and increases Enmity. 3 Stagger Gauge Damage. Part of the Holy Trinity (Pummel / Punishment / Judgment).

specs.text: Deals up to 12% more damage when fewer targets hit
[Punishing Strike] grants extra damage on hit

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.desc: Deals damage to a target afflicted with Stun or Knockdown within 4m with a 30% chance to inflict Knockdown for 3s. 100% chance to inflict Knockdown on NPC targets. 5% chance to trigger vs targets with Incapacitated Immunity. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage. ALTERNATE BUILD: at Lv20 with 'Changes to AoE Skill', enables AOE Knockdown.

specs.text: +100% damage to targets with Incapacitated Immunity
